stemMarkdown: In what ratio must a solution containing 10% acid be mixed with a solution containing 36% acid to obtain a mixture that is 24% acid? Give the ratio (cheaper : dearer) in simplest form, e.g. '3:2'.
solutionMarkdown: By alligation: $\dfrac{\text{cheaper}}{\text{dearer}} = \dfrac{y - z}{z - x} = \dfrac{36 - 24}{24 - 10} = \dfrac{12}{14} = 6:7$ (after simplifying by dividing both terms by 2).
